body: Reasoning about the 3D world from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While modern MLLMs handle single-image inputs effectively, they struggle to integrate evidence across viewpoints into a coherent 3D understanding. A growing body of work attempts to close this gap by injecting 3D awareness into MLLMs, either by boosting fine-grained pixel-level cross-view correspondence or by fusing features from 3D geometry foundation models, yet a substantial gap to human reasoning persists. In this work, we revisit human spatial reasoning, which suggests that rather than relying on fine-grained geometry cues, humans roughly identify common objects across views, infer the relative geometry between viewpoints, and assemble a coarse 3D layout of the scene. Inspired by this process, we introduce Imagine3D-LLM, an MLLM that learns to assemble a similar compact 3D representation of the scene and conditions its answer on this representation. Concretely, we append a small set of learnable summary tokens after the image tokens, decode them into a compact 3D Gaussian Splatting representation supervised by a photometric reconstruction loss, and train jointly with the standard next-token prediction objective. Notably, although only the summary tokens receive direct reconstruction supervision, this objective also induces stronger cross-frame correspondence within the LLM's underlying image features, suggesting that learning to reconstruct propagates 3D-aware signals throughout the model. As a result, Imagine3D-LLM consistently outperforms prior approaches across multiple spatial reasoning and 3D understanding benchmarks, suggesting that imagining the scene can be more effective than being told its pixel-wise geometry.
summaryZh: Imagine3D-LLM提出了一种创新的多模态大模型架构，旨在解决模型在处理多视角图像时难以构建连贯3D空间理解的难题。该模型通过在图像特征后添加可学习的摘要标记，将其解码为紧凑的3D高斯溅射表示，并结合光度重建损失进行联合训练。这种方法不仅增强了模型对场景的几何感知能力，还通过重建任务诱导了更强的跨帧对应关系。实验结果显示，该模型在多项空间推理与3D理解基准测试中均优于现有方法，证明了“先想象3D场景再回答”的策略在多模态任务中的有效性。

glossary.explanationZh: 多模态大语言模型，能够处理文本、图像等多种输入。
一种高效的3D场景表示与渲染技术，用于构建紧凑的几何模型。
空间推理，指模型理解物体在三维空间中位置与关系的能力。
光度重建损失，用于监督模型从图像中恢复3D结构。
